messages.text: Morning all. Got a heated voicemail from {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0022}} last night. Says the June statement for {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00049}} shows a cost basis that doesn't match what they have in their own records. Anyone seen this on other statements?

Not on my book, but I did get one from {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0073}} yesterday. Different issue though: the cash management statement for {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00156}} doesn't show the sweep activity, just the ending balance.

Kelly, can you tell me which lots they're disputing? If it's the tax lots from the transfer in, PortfolioMgr sometimes defaults to average cost after a rebalance. I can pull the lot detail this morning.

That'd help. They mentioned a position they bought in 2021 that now shows a higher basis than expected. I'll call back at 10 once I know more. Their callback number is in ClientHub: {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0022}}.
Heads up, two statement complaints in one morning is a pattern. Grace, are we sure nothing changed in the statement template last cycle? I recall ops mentioning a format tweak in June.
Good flag Scott. There was a layout change, but it wasn't supposed to touch basis or sweep detail. Let's log both complaints in ClientHub under one tag so we can trace them. James, please create it.
On it. Tagging both as STMT-JUN so Ops and Tech can filter. Should I attach the PDFs or just reference the account?
Reference the account only, keep PDFs in DocVault. No client details in the tag description please.

Pulled the lots. The 2021 position was adjusted for a corporate action, and the statement is showing the post-adjustment basis. The client's records probably show the original. Basis is correct, but the statement doesn't footnote the adjustment.
That makes sense, thanks Michael. Can you send me a one-page summary of the adjustment so I can walk {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0022}} through it? They're pretty anxious about the tax impact.
Will do by 9:30. I'll show original basis, the adjustment, and the resulting basis side by side. Might be worth suggesting they loop in their CPA.

Update on the sweep issue: the statement only shows ending balance because the activity section got moved to page 3 in the new layout. Nothing is missing, just buried. I'll email {{CLIENT_EMAIL:c_0073}} with a marked-up page.
So both are really presentation problems, not data errors. We should ask Tech to add a basis adjustment footnote and put sweep activity back on page 1. Grace, want me to open the ticket?
Yes please, Scott. Mark it priority for the August cycle and cc me. I'd also like a short heads-up in this channel so advisors are ready if more calls come in.

Spoke with {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0022}}. Walked through the summary and they're satisfied with the explanation. Will send a follow-up note today and ask that they confirm with their CPA. Closing this one out in ClientHub.
